_comment: Single source of truth for user-facing error codes and messages. 'messages' covers document (PDF) errors; 'web_messages' covers webpage errors. The engine (Python) and the website (TypeScript) are each tested against this file so their wording can never drift apart.

messages.not_pdf: This file isn't a PDF. Choose a file that ends in .pdf and was saved as a PDF.
messages.empty_file: This file is empty. Choose the PDF again, or re-save it and try once more.
messages.file_too_large: This PDF is larger than the current size limit. Choose a smaller file.
messages.too_many_pages: This PDF has more pages than the current page limit. Choose a shorter document.
messages.password_protected: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password in your PDF reader, save a copy, and upload that copy.
messages.corrupted: This PDF appears to be damaged and can't be read. Re-download or re-export it and try again.
messages.no_pages: This PDF has no pages to compare. Choose a different file.
messages.extraction_failed: Unable to read this PDF's contents. Try re-saving it as a new PDF and upload it again.

web_messages.url_not_allowed: This address can't be checked. DiffNexa only reads public web pages over http or https, and some sites ask not to be read automatically.
web_messages.url_unreachable: That page couldn't be reached. Check the address is correct and the site is online, then try again.
web_messages.url_not_html: That address isn't a web page. DiffNexa reads web pages; for a PDF, use PDF Compare instead.
web_messages.page_needs_javascript: This page builds its content in the browser, so DiffNexa can't read it yet. Pages that work today are ones whose text is in the page itself.
web_messages.page_too_large: That page is larger than DiffNexa can read. Try a specific page rather than a very long one.
web_messages.snapshot_mismatch: That saved capture is for a different address. Choose the capture that matches the page you're checking.
web_messages.snapshot_unreadable: That file isn't a DiffNexa capture, or it's damaged. Choose the file you downloaded when you captured the page.
web_messages.fetch_timeout: That page took too long to respond. It may be slow right now, so try again in a moment.
web_messages.engine_unavailable: The service that reads web pages isn't responding right now. Nothing is wrong with the address you entered.
web_messages.bad_request: Something was missing from that request. Enter a web address and try again.
